'a search for CBQ-LOCAL, Talagrand, PalettePriceCertificate, Conjecture7.1, CBZ-MATH-198 and main#684 found none' is literally false for main#684. It occurs 7 times in cand_final.json, in two unrelated accounting_dispositions entries: the Layer A scan triage (01XJMJ) and the remote branch class inventory. items.exact_boundary: Only the following, in the source's wording, and nothing stronger. (1) The unrestricted P15 targets (primary Conjecture 7.1 and the arXiv Conjecture 1.2 variant), i.e. assertions of the Props ThresholdStatement, ModernThresholdConjecture, PrizeStatement, DownsetPrizeStatement and HistoricalPrizeConjecture of formal/General/Threshold.lean at suitable universal constants, are recorded as unproved and are not asserted. (2) Universal existence of PalettePriceCertificate under the high-mass hypothesis (the hcert premise of ThresholdStatement_of_certificates) is recorded as unproved and is not asserted. (3) The handwritten examples of Sections 5a-5f of a private note (factor-one K=2, fractional/integral accounting failures, overlapping-clique coverage specialization) are recorded only by description; their statements, hypotheses and derivations are not in this repository. This record gives no truth value to (1)-(3). The definitions and conditional theorems of Threshold.lean are outside this item and are accounted with that file.

theorem localCover_amalgamation_of_safety {b K : ℕ}
    (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (blk : X → Fin b) (P : Fin b → Finset (Fin K))
    (k : Fin b → ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i)

theorem localCover_amalgamation {b K : ℕ}
    (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (blk : X → Fin b) (P : Fin b → Finset (Fin K))
    (k : Fin b → ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i)
    (hsize : ∀ i, k i ≤ (P i).card)
    (hPS : paletteSeparated D blk P)
    (G : Fin b → Finset (Finset X))
    (_hgsub : ∀ i g, g ∈ G i → g ⊆ block blk i)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, generatorCover (localFamily D blk i) (k i) (G i)) :
    generatorCover D K (Finset.univ.biUnion G) := by

items.hypotheses: Section variables: X a Type with Fintype and DecidableEq (line 5). Both declarations: b K : ℕ; D with hD : decreasing D; blk : X → Fin b; P : Fin b → Finset (Fin K); k with hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i and hsize : ∀ i, k i ≤ (P i).card; G : Fin b → Finset (Finset X) with the ambient hlocal, where generatorCover quantifies every U : Finset X. items.title: General.Overlap snapshot overlap-6: actual-restriction mass and hazard lemmas with conditional witness-load budgets

statements.text:
theorem restrictionMass_eq_ambient (D : Finset (Finset X)) (p : X → ℝ) (g : Finset X) :
    restrictionMass D p g =
      ∑ U : Finset X, if U ∩ g ∈ D then weight p U else 0 := by

theorem restrictionHazardStar_pos (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (g : Finset X) (hg : g.Nonempty) (hbad : g ∉ D) :
    0 < restrictionHazardStar D g := by

theorem restriction_fullGroundPriceBound (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (g : Finset X) (hg : g.Nonempty) (hbad : g ∉ D) (p c : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v ∧ c v ≤ phi (p v)) :
    genPrice c g ≤ cappedHazard (1 / restrictionHazardStar D g) (restrictionMass D p g) := by

theorem weightedHazard_of_productBound (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (G : Finset (Finset X)) (hnonempty : ∀ g ∈ G, g.Nonempty)
    (hbad : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∉ D) (p : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hmu : 0 < muOf D p)
    (hprod : muOf D p ≤ ∏ g ∈ G,
      (restrictionMass D p g) ^ (1 / (L * restrictionHazardStar D g))) :
    (∑ g ∈ G, (-Real.log (restrictionMass D p g)) / restrictionHazardStar D g) ≤
      L * (-Real.log (muOf D p)) := by

theorem witnessLoad_budget_of_weightedHazard (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (K : ℕ) (G : Finset (Finset X))
    (hG : generatorCover D K G)
    (hnonempty : ∀ g ∈ G, g.Nonempty) (hbad : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∉ D)
    (p c : X → ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v ∧ c v ≤ phi (p v)) (L : ℝ)
    (hweighted : 0 < muOf D p →
      (∑ g ∈ G, (-Real.log (restrictionMass D p g)) / restrictionHazardStar D g) ≤
        L * (-Real.log (muOf D p))) :
    (0 < muOf D p → famPrice c G ≤ L * (-Real.log (muOf D p))) ∧
    (∃ H : Finset (Finset X), generatorCover D K H ∧
      famPrice c H ≤ cappedHazard L (muOf D p)) ∧
    coverCost D K c ≤ cappedHazard L (muOf D p) := by

theorem witnessLoad_budget_of_productBound (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (K : ℕ) (G : Finset (Finset X))
    (hG : generatorCover D K G)
    (hnonempty : ∀ g ∈ G, g.Nonempty) (hbad : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∉ D)
    (p c : X → ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v ∧ c v ≤ phi (p v)) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hprod : 0 < muOf D p → muOf D p ≤ ∏ g ∈ G,
      (restrictionMass D p g) ^ (1 / (L * restrictionHazardStar D g))) :
    (0 < muOf D p → famPrice c G ≤ L * (-Real.log (muOf D p))) ∧
    (∃ H : Finset (Finset X), generatorCover D K H ∧
      famPrice c H ≤ cappedHazard L (muOf D p)) ∧
    coverCost D K c ≤ cappedHazard L (muOf D p) :=

theorem restrictionMass_eq_ambient (D : Finset (Finset X)) (p : X → ℝ) (g : Finset X) :
    restrictionMass D p g =
      ∑ U : Finset X, if U ∩ g ∈ D then weight p U else 0 := by

theorem restriction_fullGroundPriceBound (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (g : Finset X) (hg : g.Nonempty) (hbad : g ∉ D) (p c : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v ∧ c v ≤ phi (p v)) :
    genPrice c g ≤ cappedHazard (1 / restrictionHazardStar D g) (restrictionMass D p g) := by

theorem weightedHazard_of_productBound (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (G : Finset (Finset X)) (hnonempty : ∀ g ∈ G, g.Nonempty)
    (hbad : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∉ D) (p : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hmu : 0 < muOf D p)
    (hprod : muOf D p ≤ ∏ g ∈ G,
      (restrictionMass D p g) ^ (1 / (L * restrictionHazardStar D g))) :
    (∑ g ∈ G, (-Real.log (restrictionMass D p g)) / restrictionHazardStar D g) ≤
      L * (-Real.log (muOf D p)) := by

theorem witnessLoad_budget_of_productBound (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (K : ℕ) (G : Finset (Finset X))
    (hG : generatorCover D K G)
    (hnonempty : ∀ g ∈ G, g.Nonempty) (hbad : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∉ D)
    (p c : X → ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v ∧ c v ≤ phi (p v)) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hprod : 0 < muOf D p → muOf D p ≤ ∏ g ∈ G,
      (restrictionMass D p g) ^ (1 / (L * restrictionHazardStar D g))) :
    (0 < muOf D p → famPrice c G ≤ L * (-Real.log (muOf D p))) ∧
    (∃ H : Finset (Finset X), generatorCover D K H ∧
      famPrice c H ≤ cappedHazard L (muOf D p)) ∧
    coverCost D K c ≤ cappedHazard L (muOf D p) :=

theorem emptyWitnessFamily_coverCost (D : Finset (Finset X)) (K : ℕ) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v) (hcover : generatorCover D K ∅) : coverCost D K c ≤ 0 := by

theorem muOf_le_prod_localMass {b : ℕ} (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (blk : X → Fin b) (p : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) :
    muOf D p ≤ ∏ i, localMass D blk p i := by

theorem independentBlockHazard {b : ℕ} (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (blk : X → Fin b) (p : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) (hmu : 0 < muOf D p) :
    (∑ i, (1 - localMass D blk p i)) ≤ ∑ i, -Real.log (localMass D blk p i) ∧
      (∑ i, -Real.log (localMass D blk p i)) ≤ -Real.log (muOf D p) := by

theorem budget_of_union_cover {b : ℕ} (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (blk : X → Fin b) (p c : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v)
    (K : ℕ) (G : Fin b → Finset (Finset X))
    (hG : generatorCover D K (Finset.univ.biUnion G))
    (hlocal : ∀ i, famPrice c (G i) ≤ phi (1 - localMass D blk p i)) :
    (famPrice c (Finset.univ.biUnion G) ≤ ∑ i, phi (1 - localMass D blk p i)) ∧
    (∃ H : Finset (Finset X), generatorCover D K H ∧
      famPrice c H ≤ cappedHazard 1 (muOf D p)) ∧
    coverCost D K c ≤ cappedHazard 1 (muOf D p) := by

theorem paletteSeparated_budget {b K : ℕ} (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (blk : X → Fin b) (P : Fin b → Finset (Fin K))
    (k : Fin b → ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (hsize : ∀ i, k i ≤ (P i).card)
    (hPS : paletteSeparated D blk P) (p c : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v)
    (G : Fin b → Finset (Finset X))
    (hgsub : ∀ i g, g ∈ G i → g ⊆ block blk i)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, generatorCover (localFamily D blk i) (k i) (G i))
    (hprice : ∀ i, famPrice c (G i) ≤ phi (1 - localMass D blk p i)) :
    (famPrice c (Finset.univ.biUnion G) ≤ ∑ i, phi (1 - localMass D blk p i)) ∧
    (∃ H : Finset (Finset X), generatorCover D K H ∧
      famPrice c H ≤ cappedHazard 1 (muOf D p)) ∧
    coverCost D K c ≤ cappedHazard 1 (muOf D p) :=

theorem paletteSeparated_coverCost {b K : ℕ} (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (blk : X → Fin b) (P : Fin b → Finset (Fin K))
    (k : Fin b → ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (hsize : ∀ i, k i ≤ (P i).card)
    (hPS : paletteSeparated D blk P) (p c : X → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v ∧ p v ≤ 1) (hc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ c v)
    (G : Fin b → Finset (Finset X))
    (hgsub : ∀ i g, g ∈ G i → g ⊆ block blk i)

theorem decomposable_iff_union (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (k : ℕ) (U : Finset X) : decomposable D k U ↔ unionDecomposable D k U := by

theorem decomposable_iff_unionCoverable (D : Finset (Finset X)) (hD : decreasing D)
    (k : ℕ) (U : Finset X) : decomposable D k U ↔ unionCoverable D k U := by

theorem prizeStatement_iff_downset (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    PrizeStatement q ↔ DownsetPrizeStatement q := by

theorem cappedHazard_le_half_of_high_mass (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (m : ℝ)
    (hm : 1 - 1 / (2 * (k : ℝ)) ≤ m) : cappedHazard 1 m ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by

theorem threshold_cover_of_paletteCertificate (D : Finset (Finset X))
    (hD : decreasing D) (K : ℕ) (hK : 2 ≤ K) (L : ℝ) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hmass : 1 - 1 / (2 * (K : ℝ)) ≤ muOf D (fun _ => p))
    (hcert : PalettePriceCertificate D K (fun _ => p) (fun _ => p / L)) :
    ∃ H : Finset (Finset X), generatorCover D K H ∧
      (∑ g ∈ H, (p / L) ^ g.card) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by

theorem ThresholdStatement_of_certificates (K : ℕ) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hcert : ∀ (Y : Type) [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (p : ℝ),
      0 < p → p < 1 → ∀ D : Finset (Finset Y), decreasing D →
        1 - 1 / (2 * (K : ℝ)) ≤ muOf D (fun _ => p) →
        PalettePriceCertificate D K (fun _ => p) (fun _ => p / L)) :
    ThresholdStatement K L := by
